messages:
alex: Quick sync — we need to lock final launch criteria for Dedicated reserved pools autoscale: triggers for scale-up, soft-quota behavior during spikes, and oncall playbook for SLA breaches. volunteers?

maria: where are we on telemetry signals? need reliable indicators before prod.

sam: we have tail-latency, queue-length, GPU-util. current plan:
- scale-up: avg queue > 80% for 30s OR p95 latency > 500ms for 60s
- scale-down: queue < 20% for 5m

priya: add soft-quota mode that returns 429 for non-critical tenants and routes critical ones to hosted fallback. limits noisy neighbors and keeps SLAs for paid tiers.

jamal: contract note: can't silently preempt enterprise. hosted fallback must be opt-in in contract or use model-variant fallback first.

alex: two-tier fallback plan: (1) model-variant on same pool (quantized), (2) hosted region fallback (opt-in only).

maria: ops: how visible to SRE? need per-tenant token metrics + alerts on error-rate and avg latency.

sam: metrics we can emit: dedicated_pool.{tenant}.q_len, .p95_lat, .preempt_count, .fallback_count. alert if .fallback_count > 0 for >1m for paying customer.

priya: launch gates: 2 canary customers for 2 weeks, zero regression on p95, documented runbook tested by oncall. include a dark-run where fallback_count increments but routing doesn't occur until enabled.

jamal: pick 1 low-risk and 1 medium-risk canary. Ops should have a throttling override to force-scale-up during tests.

alex: owners: sam (metrics/runtime), priya (policy/rollout), maria (observability/alerts), jamal (contracts/billing). confirm?

sam: ack. config snippet I'll land:
```json
{
  "autoscale": {
    "scale_up": {"q_threshold_pct": 80, "duration_s": 30, "p95_ms": 500, "p95_duration_s": 60},
    "scale_down": {"q_threshold_pct": 20, "duration_s": 300}
  },
  "fallback": {"order": ["model_variant","hosted"], "hosted_opt_in": true}
}
```

priya: ack. rollout steps: staging dark-run -> canary1 -> canary2 -> GA. add per-tenant toggle `autoscale_mode: conservative|balanced|aggressive`. conservative disables soft-fallback; aggressive favors fast scale-up.

maria: ack. dashboards + alert doc. question: SLO breach action? auto-scale + page on critical customer fallback?

jamal: page on critical fallback or >5% error-rate sustained 3m. billing wants automated billing flag if hosted-fallback minutes > threshold/month for credits reconciliation.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled deploy for autoscale runtime hooks at 2230013000 — will run canary-stage only.

alex: next steps: 1) I'll write launch criteria doc 2) priya owns rollout 3) sam lands metrics/hooks 4) maria owns alerts/dashboard 5) jamal drafts contract opt-in wording. targets: dark-run in 2w, canary in 4w.

priya: include graceful degradation: if scale-up fails and fallback not opted-in, apply token-shed (20%) and return header `x-degraded: true` so clients can backoff.

sam: added. logs will include `degrade_reason`.

maria: I'll add Ops playbook: revert autoscale policy, kill canary, manually route tenant off dedicated. will link runbook in doc.

jamal: I'll circulate an enterprise amendment for hosted opt-in + credits policy.

alex: perfect. meeting adjourned. tagging follow-ups: @sam @priya @maria @jamal — drop PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
file_note: thread captures product discussion to finalize autoscale launch criteria, telemetry, fallback opt-in, canary gating, owners, and contractual/billing considerations
